body:
PR-2778 round 2 of 2 is pushed for independent re-review (TASK-1981 non-completing slice).
https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/2778
Verified/pushed/forge head: 9aec7abd4653b2a9ed3caaecc87ca7693d1b1eeb

1. CI failure identified from job 118720135550: gc_runs_after_the_store_window expected free but observed held. Reproduced old binary failure locally; the unchanged assertion now passes 1/1 with rebuilt merged-source CLI.
2. Both auto/aggressive GC run outside AIDA's store writer lock. Config write and squash history rewrite retain the lock; post-squash GC runs after unlock. Already-locked callers defer/refuse GC. No forced foreground detach override remains.
3. Explicit auto-GC uses normal Git config precedence (global/system/local), with off skipping even an existing nonzero local threshold. Isolated-child global-zero/off/unset test passes. Existing TASK-1033 sync policy local500/detachtrue is unchanged and documented distinctly.
4. Real contention barriers pass for parent-tag heal (reload preserves peer title/new parent), orphan queue heal (rechecks peer removal), and compaction rewrite (backup+snapshot include peer). Post-squash pack assertions prove GC actually runs after unlock; ordinary compact finishes while another writer holds the lock. PR body/inventory list remaining F7 gaps.

Final-source local gates: fast 32/32; test-touched 202 CLI + 140 core; original GC regression 1/1; every test target compiled (920.7s, no full suite executed). Logs /tmp/task-1981-r2-{merged-fast,merged-tests,compile,gc-regression}.log, all corresponding .status=0.

Base context: merged origin/main 1456ad35b0 cleanly before final gates. The last fetch after verification found new main 03fe56b082 (BUG-2190, list disclosure), one commit ahead of this verified head and touching none of the repair's changed files. I froze/pushed the verified SHA and disclosed this in the PR body; latest-base integration remains necessary before merge. No new-head CI or review result claimed. No own verdict, hold-clear or ship.

Author self-check for this rework: 3 fresh-context rounds, zero authority. Corrected local-policy doc overclaim, doctor fixture directory selection, and the backup-ref wildcard found by test execution. Final checker independently proved the Git query and found no further issues. This is not independent review.

F6/F7 remain open; no publication scratch draft applied. Remote head will remain frozen during re-review. Relay next session can develop the remaining slice locally while awaiting integration of this non-completing PR.
subject: PR-2778 round 2 ready (TASK-1981)
